subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 4: I want to be a doctor!
outcomes: I can listen and match people with jobs and transport.
I can use He's and She's.
I can write about my dream job and my family.

tf.why: Yes! He's is the short form of He is.

tf.s: In 'My family', grandma is a chef.
tf.why: Right! My grandma is a chef.

tf.s: In 'My family', grandma goes to work by bus.
tf.why: Grandma goes to work by car.

tf.s: In 'My family', the uncle is an artist.
tf.why: Yes! My uncle is an artist.

tf.s: In 'My family', the brother is a pilot.
The brother goes to work by motorbike.
tf.why: Well done! He goes by motorbike.

tf.s: Before you listen, you look at the people and the transport in the picture.
tf.why: Great! Looking first helps you listen.

tf.s: We write: My uncle is a artist.
tf.why: Artist starts with a vowel sound: an artist.

tf.s: In 'My family', the uncle goes to work by bus.
tf.why: Yes! The uncle goes to work by bus.

boxes.q: What is the long form of She's?

boxes.why: She's a doctor. = She is a doctor.

boxes.q: Which job in 'My family' uses an?
Card: a nurse and a car (a man). Which is correct?
o: He's a nurse. He goes to work by car.
She's a nurse. He goes to work by car.
He's nurse. He goes by a car.
boxes.why: He's a nurse. He goes to work by car.

boxes.q: Who is she? (an old woman in the family)
boxes.why: Grandma is an old woman in the family.

boxes.q: Complete: I want to be ___ astronaut.
boxes.why: Astronaut starts with a vowel sound.

boxes.q: Complete: My mum is a teacher. ___ goes to work by car.
boxes.why: Mum is a woman, so we use She.
Chef starts with a consonant sound.

hunt.q: She's a teacher. She goes by …

mcq.q: What is the short form of He is?
In 'My family', who is a chef?
In 'My family', who goes to work by motorbike?
mcq.why: My brother goes to work by motorbike.

mcq.q: Which word is a family member?
mcq.why: An uncle is a family member.

mcq.q: Write about your dad: he is a pilot and he drives a car to work.
o: My dad is a pilot. He goes to work by car.
My dad is an pilot. He goes to work by car.
My dad is a pilot. She goes to work by car.
My dad is a pilot. He go to work by car.
mcq.why: a pilot, He, goes: all correct.

mcq.q: Describe a secret card: a chef (a man) and a bus.
o: He's a chef. He goes to work by bus.
She's a chef. She goes to work by bus.
He's a chef. He goes to work by a bus.
He chef. He goes to work by bus.
mcq.why: He's a chef. He goes to work by bus.

mcq.q: Circle: My brother goes to work by car / motorbike.
mcq.why: In the text, the brother goes by motorbike.

mcq.q: Why do we write an artist?
o: Artist starts with a vowel sound.
mcq.why: We use an before a vowel sound.

o: My grandma is a chef. He goes to work by car.
My grandma is a chef. She goes to work by car.
My uncle is an artist. He goes to work by bus.
My brother is a firefighter. He goes to work by motorbike.
mcq.why: Grandma is a woman, so we need She.

mcq.q: What helps you most before you listen and draw lines?
o: Look at the people and transport in the picture.
mcq.why: Looking first tells you what to listen for.
